result.algorithm_note: Each of K=64 cells holds (value, index). Per cycle, all cells in parallel: (1) compare own value with the new input scalar, (2) consult right-neighbor's compare result, (3) 3-way mux to either keep self, shift right-neighbor in, or accept new input as insertion point. Strictly local per-cell logic = 1 compare + 1 mux, fits well under 4 ns.
